en: A colorized postcard view of a lively European town square surrounded by multi‑story historic buildings with red-tiled roofs. In the center is a large monument with statues and steps, and many café-style tables and umbrellas fill the square. People stroll around the plaza. On the hillside in the background stands a prominent clock tower. Handwritten text in German covers the top portion. Printed caption at the upper left reads 'Graz, Hauptplatz.'
